description: Read your owned life goals and progress. goal_id selects one; status defaults active, all includes completed goals. Each goal carries a computed progress object: kind, percent, this period, change on the previous period, and pace (null without a target date or enough history; never estimate one). Not calendar events or streak trackers. ($0.01; API key required)

status.description: Goal status filter, default active, e.g. active.

name: get_goals
title: Get Goals
